sentences.text:
This Criminal Petition Is Filed By The vs Additional Public
Prosecutor For The on 21 July, 2020

Author: B.Krishna Mohan
Bench: B.Krishna Mohan
 The Hon'Ble Sri Justice B.Krishna Mohan
 Criminal Petition No.2625 of 2020
Order:

This criminal petition is filed by the petitioner/ A-17, seeking to quash the proceedings in FIR No.190 of 2020, dated 17.06.2020 of Kavali I Town Police Station, SPSR Nellore District, registered for the offences punishable under Sections 272, 273, and 328 I.P.C, Section 59(i) of Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 and Section 34(A) of Andhra Pradesh Excise Act.

entities.text: Kavali I Town Police Station, SPSR Nellore District
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: Heard the learned counsel for the petitioner and the learned Additional Public Prosecutor for the respondent-State.

It is submitted by both the learned counsels that the present criminal petition in so far as the offences under Indian Penal Code and Food Safety and Standards Act are concerned is squarely covered by the order dated 05.03.2020, in Crl.P.No.5103 of 2019 and batch.

Following the order passed in the aforementioned batch of criminal petitions, and for the reasons recorded therein, the Criminal Petition is partly allowed and except the provision registered under Section 34(A) of A.P.Excise Act, the other provisions viz., Sections 272, 273, and 328 I.P.C and Section 59(i) of Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 in FIR No.190 of 2020, dated 17.06.2020 of Kavali I Town Police Station, SPSR Nellore District, are quashed.

entities.text: Kavali I Town Police Station, SPSR Nellore District
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: Accordingly, the Criminal Petition is disposed of.
Miscellaneous petitions, if any pending, shall also stand closed in consequence.

B.KRISHNA MOHAN, J Dated 21.07.2020 KA THE HON'BLE SRI JUSTICE B.KRISHNA MOHAN CRIMINAL PETITION NO.2625 of 2020 Dated 21.07.2020 KA This Criminal Petition Is Filed By The vs Additional Public Prosecutor For The on 21 July, 2020 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/119046362/
